goal: 找到共同爱好并约好一起做

n1.speaker: 同学 Lily
n1.line: Hi! The weekend is coming. What do you enjoy doing in your free time?
n1.lineCn: 嗨!周末要来了。你空闲时间喜欢做什么?

grammar.name: enjoy + doing
grammar.note: enjoy 后接动名词 doing,表示"喜欢做某事"。

options.text: I enjoy reading comics and playing badminton in the park.
options.textCn: 我喜欢看漫画,还有在公园打羽毛球。
options.feedback: 用 enjoy + doing 说出两个爱好,信息具体。
回答太简单,话题无法展开。
答非所问,问的是爱好不是身份。

n2.speaker: 同学 Lily
n2.line: Really? I love playing badminton too! I am not very good at it, but I really enjoy playing after school.
n2.lineCn: 真的吗?我也爱打羽毛球!我打得不算好,但我很喜欢放学后去打。

grammar.name: be good at + doing
grammar.note: be good at 后接动名词,表示"擅长做某事",not very good at 表示不太擅长。

options.text: What a coincidence! I have been thinking of finding a partner to practice with.
options.textCn: 太巧了!我一直在想找个球伴一起练习。
options.feedback: 主动回应共同爱好,还提出练习需求。
反应冷淡,明明有共同爱好却不懂得接话。

n3.speaker: 同学 Lily
n3.line: Come on, everyone likes something! What about reading, drawing, or playing sports? Which one do you like doing most?
n3.lineCn: 别这样,每个人都有喜欢的东西!读书、画画或者运动呢?你最喜欢哪个?

grammar.name: like doing most
grammar.note: like + doing 表习惯性爱好,most 表示"最喜欢"。

options.text: I like drawing most! I often draw cartoons in my notebook after class.
options.textCn: 我最喜欢画画!我经常在课后在笔记本上画卡通。
options.feedback: 说出了具体爱好,还补充了细节。
对一切都说讨厌,同学也无话可说。

n4.speaker: 同学 Lily
n4.line: Me too! Playing badminton with someone is much more fun than practicing alone. Have you joined any club?
n4.lineCn: 我也是!有人一起打羽毛球比一个人练有意思多了。你加入了什么社团吗?

grammar.name: 动名词作主语
grammar.note: Playing badminton with someone 是动名词短语作主语,谓语用单数。

options.text: Not yet. But I am thinking of joining the school badminton club. Do you want to join it together?
options.textCn: 还没有。不过我在考虑加入学校羽毛球社。你想一起加入吗?
options.feedback: 主动提出一起加入社团,抓住了共同爱好的机会。
当面拒绝刚找到的共同爱好,错失良机。

n5.speaker: 同学 Lily
n5.line: I thought we could be partners since we both like badminton. Are you interested in playing together this weekend?
n5.lineCn: 既然我们都喜欢羽毛球,我还以为我们可以当搭档呢。这个周末你感兴趣一起打球吗?

grammar.name: be interested in + doing
grammar.note: be interested in 后接动名词,表示"对做某事感兴趣"。

options.text: Yes, I am really interested in playing with you! How about Saturday afternoon?
options.textCn: 当然,我很想和你一起打!周六下午怎么样?
options.feedback: 抓住机会挽回,还主动约了具体时间。
不置可否,对方不好安排。

n6.speaker: 同学 Lily
n6.line: Saturday afternoon works for me! I cannot wait to start playing with you. Is there anything you enjoy doing after the game?
n6.lineCn: 周六下午没问题!我都等不及要和你打球了。打完球之后你还喜欢做点什么?

grammar.name: enjoy doing 的用法
grammar.note: enjoy 必须接动名词,不可接 to do,是固定搭配。

options.text: I enjoy drinking bubble tea and chatting after the game. My treat!
options.textCn: 打完球我喜欢喝奶茶聊聊天。我请客!
options.feedback: 共同爱好已找到,还延伸出第二个共同点,约定圆满。

options.text: I enjoy leaving immediately after the game.
options.textCn: 打完球我喜欢马上走人。
options.feedback: 刚约好一起玩就说要立刻走,氛围尴尬。

success.speaker: 同学 Lily
success.line: Ha, you are so fun! Then it is a date: Saturday afternoon, badminton and bubble tea!
success.lineCn: 哈,你真有趣!那就约定了:周六下午,羽毛球加奶茶!

fail1.speaker: 同学 Lily
fail1.line: Oh... okay then. If you ever find a hobby, let me know. See you!
fail1.lineCn: 哦……好吧。如果你哪天找到爱好,告诉我一声。再见!

fail2.speaker: 同学 Lily
fail2.line: Alright, maybe another time. Enjoy your weekend!
fail2.lineCn: 好吧,也许下次吧。周末愉快!
